stem:
Craig folded a piece of paper in half and cut out a shape.

[Image: Folded paper with cut-out shape]

Draw a picture to show what the cut-out shape will look like when it is opened up and flattened out.

descriptors: The drawing of the cut-out shape corresponds to figure A.
The drawing of the remaining piece of paper corresponds to figure B.
Drawings correspond to figures E or F or G.

scoring_notes: Note: See the examples above. The accuracy in drawing is not important, nor is the size of the figure.
figure_description: A vertical rectangular outline representing a piece of paper folded in half vertically. The vertical left edge is labeled with an arrow pointing to it and the word "fold". Along this folded edge, a cut-out profile is drawn: starting from a point on the left edge, a straight line segment angles up and right, turns back down and to the left to form a sharp inward notch, then curves outward to the right in a rounded semicircle, and finally curves back down and to the left to meet the folded edge at the bottom.
